snippet.title: Cold Zero: The Last Stand / No Mercy Trailer - 2002
snippet.description:
Cold Zero: The Last Stand - Europe
Cold Zero: No Mercy - United States
Cold Zero: Final Countdown - Russia
Cold Zero is a mixed-genre computer game developed by Drago Entertainment and released by JoWooD Productions in 2003 for the Windows platform . In Russia, the localizer and publisher was Russobit-M.

During the development of the game, the developers' intentions underwent a number of changes, which also affected its genre. Initially, the project was conceived as an action game, then acquired stealth aspects, and was subsequently characterized by tactical and role-playing elements.
